_note: Synthetic content & evidence library of Sablewood Cloud Partners (fictional Google Cloud partner): case studies (fictional clients), past SOWs, capability evidence, blogs and solution offerings (kind 'agent'). 'named_reference' = the client agreed to be named; 'approved_external' = cleared for public/client-facing use.

case_studies.title: Regional insurer cuts claims triage time 42% with Gemini
case_studies.challenge: 150,000 first-notice-of-loss submissions a year triaged by hand; 26-minute median triage and 3-day storm backlogs.
case_studies.solution: AI triage assistant that classifies claims, extracts key fields from documents and drafts routing notes, with mandatory adjuster review and PII redaction before prompts.

outcomes.metric: Field extraction accuracy (audited sample of 1,200 claims)

case_studies.title: Regional transit agency moves 2,400 staff to Google Workspace in 9 weeks
case_studies.challenge: End-of-support on-premises email and file shares across 5 operating depots and a 24x7 control centre.
case_studies.solution: Wave-based migration by depot with floor-walkers at each cutover, a user communication plan, single sign-on with the agency's identity provider and enforced multi-factor authentication.

outcomes.value: 2,400 mailboxes and 14 TB of file shares

case_studies.title: Logistics provider gets 15-minute on-time-delivery analytics on BigQuery
case_studies.challenge: Nine operational systems and weekly spreadsheets; no shared view of on-time performance.
case_studies.solution: Streaming data platform on BigQuery ingesting transport, telematics and maintenance data, with Looker dashboards refreshed every 15 minutes.

case_studies.title: City 311 assistant resolves 61% of resident questions without an agent
case_studies.challenge: 3,500 calls a day to the 311 line, mostly repeat questions about services and schedules.
case_studies.solution: Bilingual assistant on the city website and a messaging channel, grounded only on approved city content, with live hand-off to a human agent.

case_studies.title: Credit union modernises its warehouse on BigQuery with row-level security
case_studies.challenge: Ageing on-premises warehouse; member personal data visible to too many analysts.
case_studies.solution: BigQuery warehouse with data classification, policy tags, row-level security and role-based access for 600 staff.

case_studies.title: Senior living operator rolls out Gemini Enterprise to 900 staff
case_studies.challenge: Care and office staff with little time for training and strict confidentiality rules.
case_studies.solution: Use-case-led rollout with short recorded micro-trainings, office champions and data-loss-prevention rules.

case_studies.title: Agricultural cooperative pilots a WhatsApp farmer advisory assistant
case_studies.challenge: 14,000 member farmers with limited access to agronomists.
case_studies.solution: In progress — pilot with 300 members; not yet approved for external use.

case_studies.title: Media group consolidates 14 data sources into a Looker semantic layer
case_studies.solution: Semantic layer over BigQuery — internal draft, client approval pending.

blogs.title: Model Armor in practice: guardrails for outbound model calls
key_points: Screen prompts on the way out and responses on the way back
Redact personal data with typed tokens instead of dropping the request
Block secrets and injected instructions outright
Watch spend per agent against its own baseline to catch retry loops
Model Armor and Sensitive Data Protection are the production controls

blogs.title: Five lessons from putting a claims triage assistant into production
key_points: Start with the two highest-volume claim types
Make human review mandatory where liability is high
Override reason codes are the best improvement backlog
Redact PII before prompts, not after

blogs.title: Why your Workspace migration needs a floor-walker plan
key_points: Plan floor-walkers per site and per wave, not per project
Champions on the floor beat extra training sessions on day one
Publish the mobile re-add guide before the cutover weekend
Track day-one tickets per 100 users to size support for the next wave

blogs.title: Agents that audit meetings: inside our meeting-intelligence loop
key_points: Every client meeting is scored for frustration, scope creep and disengagement with verbatim evidence
Alerts reach the project manager the same day, before the client escalates
Action items become owned, dated tasks and a decision log
An explainable churn-risk score per account drives the save plan before renewal
Recorded meetings become searchable knowledge with chapter links
